edges.reason: cost is multiplied by the user-supplied _mintAmount for the payment check.
_mintAmount feeds the cost * _mintAmount arithmetic.
_mintAmount is added to publicSupplyMinted.
publicSupplyMinted is read into the addition.
Result of the addition is written back to publicSupplyMinted.
publicMaxSupply bounds the publicSupplyMinted addition check.
maxMintAmount caps the user-supplied _mintAmount.
paused flag gates execution of mint.
maxBlocksSupply bounds the totalSupply() + _mintAmount arithmetic.
_mintAmount participates in the totalSupply() + _mintAmount check.
mint performs the totalSupply() + _mintAmount supply check.
mint executes the cost * _mintAmount arithmetic in its require chain.
mint calls nextToken to obtain a random token index.
mint loop is driven by the local index i.
Loop counter i controls the number of mint iterations.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the receiver before mint accounting completes.
block.timestamp is concatenated into the pseudo-random index input.
Timestamp (miner-influenced) seeds the keccak256 randomness.
nextToken builds the weak randomness operation from block fields and msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes presaleList to derive the caller's allowance.
presaleList quota read in presaleMint gates privileged minting.
senderLimit is initialized from presaleList[msg.sender].
_mintAmount is compared against senderLimit.
senderLimit enforces the per-address presale quota.
Decremented senderLimit is written back to presaleList.
_mintAmount is added to presaleSupplyMinted.
presaleSupplyMinted is read into the presale addition.
Result of the presale addition is written back to presaleSupplyMinted.
presaleMaxSupply bounds the presale supply addition check.
presaleMint performs the presaleSupplyMinted + _mintAmount arithmetic.
presaleMint calls nextToken for each minted token.
presaleMint assigns the nextToken result to mintIndex.
presaleMint loop is driven by the local index i.
_safeMint in presaleMint triggers an external receiver callback before quota accounting.
_addrs entries become keys written into presaleList.
_limit entries become values written into presaleList.
addPresaleList iterates over _addrs.
_newBaseURI is written to the baseURI state variable by the owner.
setBaseURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_owner is queried for balance and enumeration.
ownerTokenCount sizes the returned tokenIds array.
tokenIds is the returned array of owned token IDs.
tokenId is encoded into the returned token URI.
currentBaseURI is concatenated in the tokenURI return value.
baseURI is read through _baseURI into currentBaseURI.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
msg.sender must equal owner and receives the withdrawn balance.
withdraw executes the low-level send of the contract balance.
Value is sent to an address capable of executing a fallback during withdrawal.

normalization_plan.reason: User-supplied mint quantity is a per-call parameter of mint, not a distinct semantic entity.
Loop index only shapes control flow inside mint.
Presale quantity parameter is local to presaleMint semantics.
senderLimit is a transient copy of the presale quota inside presaleMint.
Loop index only shapes control flow inside presaleMint.
mintIndex is the transient nextToken result in presaleMint.
Address list parameter is consumed directly by addPresaleList.
Limit list parameter is consumed directly by addPresaleList.
Loop index only shapes control flow inside addPresaleList.
New URI string is the direct input stored by setBaseURI.
Queried address is the direct input of the view function.
Token count is a transient local used to size the result array.
tokenIds is the ephemeral return buffer of walletOfOwner.
Token id parameter is directly encoded by tokenURI.
currentBaseURI is a transient read of baseURI inside tokenURI.
